title: Peruvian Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew with Peruvian flavors, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and cook the onion, garlic, and peppers until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the beetroot juice, beef broth, and browned beef.
If using wine, add it to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
